app.name: FLIPNOTE
app.subtitle: Convert notes into flashcards, quizzes, and spaced revision — free and offline-first.

common.offlineMode: You are offline. Saved study material remains available.

onboarding.description: Turn lecture notes, textbook PDFs, or quick ideas into interactive flashcards and MCQ quizzes — privately on your device.
onboarding.step1Desc: Paste text, import PDFs, or scan images locally.
onboarding.step2Desc: Generate flashcards and MCQs without paid AI.
onboarding.step3Desc: Track weak topics with spaced revision.

notes.title: Smart Notes
notes.subtitle: Paste notes, import a PDF, or extract text from an image.
notes.contentPlaceholder:
Paste or type your study notes here...

Tip: Clear sentences, definitions (Term: Explanation), and bullet points produce the sharpest flashcards and quizzes.
notes.emptyDesc: Paste your notes above or import a PDF to start building your study memory.
notes.ocrExtracting: Running OCR on image (first load may take a moment)...
notes.pdfError: Could not extract PDF text. Check your connection for first-time PDF engine load or paste text directly.
notes.ocrError: OCR could not process this image. Ensure you are online for first-time OCR engine load.
notes.deleteConfirm: Delete this note? This action cannot be undone.
notes.needContent: Please enter or import some note text first.

flashcards.title: Flashcard Studio
flashcards.subtitle: Flip cards, edit Q&A, shuffle, and save study sets.
flashcards.tapToFlip: Tap card or press Space to flip
flashcards.emptyDesc: Generate flashcards from a note or open a saved study set from your Library.
flashcards.deleteCardConfirm: Remove this flashcard from the set?
flashcards.deterministicNotice: Generated locally using deterministic text analysis (no paid AI required).
flashcards.csvImportEmpty: No valid Front,Back rows found in file.

quiz.title: Quiz Engine
quiz.subtitle: Test recall with auto-generated MCQs and source explanations.
quiz.emptyDesc: Create a quiz from your notes or open a shared quiz challenge.
quiz.noQuestionsGenerated: Add more detailed sentences to your notes to generate multiple-choice questions.

revision.title: Spaced Revision
revision.subtitle: Rate recall difficulty to schedule your next review.
revision.allCaughtUpDesc: No flashcards are due right now. Study a set or review weak topics below.
revision.noWeakTopics: No weak topics flagged yet. Cards marked Difficult or missed in quizzes appear here.

library.title: Study Library
library.subtitle: Your saved notes, flashcard sets, quizzes, and community sets.
library.importPlaceholder: Paste exported FLIPNOTE JSON or a #share= link here...
library.importInvalid: Invalid study set format. Please check the JSON or link.
library.publicUnconfigured: Online community discovery is optional. Add your free Supabase URL & Anon Key in Settings to browse or publish public study sets.
library.publicEmpty: No public study sets found yet. Be the first to share one!
library.deleteConfirm: Delete this item from your local library?

sharing.title: Share Study Material
sharing.privacyNotice: Private notes are never shared automatically. Sharing only exports the selected study set or quiz.
sharing.sizeWarning: This study set is large ({size} KB). URL links over 6 KB may be truncated by some messaging apps — downloading the .json file is recommended.
sharing.supabaseRequired: Configure Supabase URL and Anon Key in Settings to publish online.

progress.title: Learning Progress
progress.subtitle: Your local study sessions, quiz accuracy, and daily activity.
progress.noActivity: Complete a flashcard session or quiz to see your progress here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize languages, appearance, optional AI, and local privacy.
settings.aiNotice: FLIPNOTE works 100% free without AI. If you have your own API key (e.g., OpenAI-compatible or Gemini API), you may optionally enable enhanced generation. Keys stay strictly in your browser.
settings.supabaseNotice: Use only your public Supabase Project URL and public Anon Key. Never enter a service_role key.
settings.deleteAllConfirm: Permanently delete ALL notes, flashcards, quizzes, and progress from this device? This cannot be undone.
settings.dataDeleted: All local data has been cleared.

auth.welcomeSubtitle: Enter your name and email to unlock your personal study workspace.
auth.invalidName: Please enter your full name (at least 2 characters).
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
